comment: Recorded from managed by ServiceControlRuntimeTests.NativePowerOnlyReleaseVectors; regenerate with OPENBLADE_REGENERATE_NATIVE_PROFILE_VECTORS. Each case starts on PluggedIn with Balanced confirmed, then reads conflicting adapter classes on ExternalUnknown power, which publishes a power-only block (blocked). after is the status once Windows reports Battery: performanceSetters lists the presets submitted by that change, and authorityClosed whether its message says the thermal write authority closed. owner names a block that is not power-only: writePause is an experimental write pause. recovered is the status after a successful observation and another power-source change.

cases.case: a classified power change applies the destination over a power-only block
a classified power change applies the destination over a power-only block under a transient read label
a block another owner holds is kept
an unresolved destination submission is not replayed
